summary: Bankhead told her Humble Warrior podcast audience in July 2026 that she 'loves' the IDF and Mossad 'to pieces.' By October she backed enforcing the Leahy Law as a full arms embargo on U.S. military aid to Israel during the Gaza assault. The embargo position opposes continued arms transfers, yet the earlier pro-IDF language and the conditions-based rather than aid-elimination framing produce a conflicted record that stops short of openly opposing U.S. support for Israel.
